messages:
jonah: proposing a new 'anchored concordance' safety-band for onboarding rwd-v6-int4-anch. goal: detect small quality regressions that standard MRR deltas miss by comparing to an anchored offline baseline + live-prod and requiring concordance across both. micro-shadow -> 0.5% -> 4% -> 20% is the plan. posting draft gate rules.

priya: interesting. can you explain the concordance metric you want to use? how is it different from MRR delta?

jonah: sure  concordance_gap = |live_delta_pct - anchored_delta_pct|. idea: if model shows a small MRR drop vs prod but anchored baseline also shows similar drop, it's likely noise. we only act when concordance_gap is small AND absolute anchored drop is small. basically require both: (1) relative MRR drop vs prod > threshold AND (2) concordance_gap < band_size OR anchored_drop > anchored_threshold triggers.

mira: here's a concrete set of rules that would be simple for the console to evaluate. include slices (longform, rerank, short-chat) and min_samples. also add soft-warning vs hard-rollback separation and a required concurrence on the 0.5% step.

jonah: console-ready snippet:
```
rollout_id: RL-20260502-21
model: rwd-v6-int4-anch
sequence:
  - micro_shadow: 00:25:00
  - steps:
      - percent: 0.5
        duration: 00:12:00
        require_concurrent_failures: true
      - percent: 4
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 20
        duration: 01:20:00
auto_fallback:
  comparisons:
    - metric: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      warn_pct: 0.5
      rollback_pct: 1.6
      anchored_baseline: true
      concordance_band_pct: 1.2  # if prod vs anchored delta diverge less than this, treat as concordant
      anchored_min_drop_pct: 0.8 # if anchored baseline also drops more than this, treat as signal
    - metric: HALLUC_PP
      comparator: absolute_increase
      warn_pp: 0.15
      rollback_pp: 0.45
  perf_guards:
    - metric: LATENCY_P95
      rollback_ms: 40
    - metric: TOKENS_PER_SEC
      rollback_pct: 18
slices:
  - name: longform
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 5000
    eval_window: 40m
  - name: rerank
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 15m
  - name: short-chat
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 2000
    eval_window: 10m
requirements:
  min_samples_per_step: 2500
  require_concurrent_for_small_steps: true
  step_stability_window: 10m
  preflight_smoke: {enabled: true, queries: 1200}
```

priya: can we also require "insufficient_data" handling: slices with <min_samples are excluded and we mark the step as "insufficient" rather than failing. and for the 0.5% step we require two independent signals (MRR + either HALLUC_PP or TOKENS_PER_SEC) before auto-rollback.

mira: yes  add an explicit min_total_samples check to avoid decisions on tiny overall windows. also longform gets 40m eval window. Concordance band helps avoid reacting to global drift in user behavior (anchored baseline catches that).

jonah: adding a soft-warning webhook to #anchored-eyeballs at warn thresholds and hard-fail to #sre-watch. we'll run a 30m micro-shadow against production traffic prior to step 0.5 to surface obvious mismatches.

sig-bot: rollout RL-20260502-21 created in staging. manual start required at /console/rollouts/RL-20260502-21. Runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/anchored-concordance (permissions required).

ops: tagging @ops for a 3h watch window once kicked. watchlist: preempt/oom, queue_depth, tokens/sec per worker. escalate if queue depth > 450 or tokens/sec drop > 12% sustained > 5m.

jonah: next steps: mira to export slice definitions + implement insufficient_data gating (ETA 30m), priya to add webhooks (ETA 20m), jonah to run micro-shadow and post preflight smoke results (ETA 50m). if any hard-fail triggers we auto-rollback and open a short blameless postmortem. :wave:
